freeze: Weights and validation rule finalized before any holdout request; no holdout assets opened.

recipe.sample_noise: One input per training object per epoch, uniformly from five paired levels.
recipe.objective: Mean smoothed retained-source d² divided by observation energy, with chart anchor penalty. Source exhaustion uses the shared geometry-only signed state-spectrum guide.
recipe.gradient_description: Analytic stable-branch gradient. Hard inertia. Source cutoff near-ties skipped, finite scaled per-observation gradient norm clipped.
recipe.validation_selector: Largest object-mean hard d²/||Y||² across validation noise, caps, and both heads. Ties retain the earliest epoch, including initialization.
